tools.name: list_supported_languages
tools.description: List all supported Indian languages for voice calls: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, English.

tools.name: initiate_voice_call
tools.description: Initiate an outbound voice call to a client in their preferred language using Gemini Live API + Twilio. Only between 08:00-19:00 IST per RBI Fair Practices Code.

tools.name: get_call_status
tools.description: Get the current status of an outbound voice call: ringing, in-progress, completed, failed, transcript.

tools.name: get_recent_calls
tools.description: Get recent outbound call history for an RM with outcomes, durations, and transcripts.

tools.name: simulate_call_outcome
tools.description: Simulate a call outcome for PoC demo purposes without placing a real Twilio call.
